result:
I've planned round 438 as **SYS-R435-SOURCE-SCAN-HELPER**, a test-only round on `142918b`, the commit gate 437 published. The decision is **CONTINUE**. I changed no app code and the store tree is clean.

**Round 437 result**
- C passed it in the browser at both viewports. STUDIO-VIS-7, STUDIO-VIS-10 and SABA-LANE-RESIZE-HANDLE are now done.
- **C's bug C-R437-01 is a Low and is deferred.** C wrote that Play shows no message right after a clip is added. My own probe shows "Loading …" and then "… is ready." do appear; playback just doesn't start until you press Play again.
- That refusal is the deliberate round-382 rule (Play waits while the audio decodes), not a regression. Making Play start by itself once decoding finishes would change behaviour, so I put it to Saba as a question in `user-review/note-round-438-play-after-decode.md`.
- The gate reviewer's and A's Lows from round 437 are deferred. The L61 lesson wrongly blamed "pointer capture"; it now states the measured fact.

**Round 438 task**
- **Why now:** five of the six source-scan tests only read the top level of `app/components/arrangement`. ARCH-SPLIT will move files into subfolders, and those files would then pass every scanner silently.
- **What A applies:** one shared test helper, built on the TypeScript parser that is already a project dependency. It walks the folder recursively and reads each tag's attributes. It flags any spread or `style=` on a tag that could override the shared class. If the parser marks a syntax error, it fails with the file and line instead of passing.
  - My first version used a hand-written tag reader. tech-lead found a Medium in it (a stray quote could make a tag run on silently), so I switched to the parser.
  - The final version was approved with Lows by tech-lead, which named its sha (`1b88d0ec…`).
- **What it closes:** 9 deferred Lows, plus the subfolder half of GATE434-S2. GATE431-REVIEW-L3 is not closed, because it lives in other test files.
- **Proof on the sketch:**
  - each closed finding has a mutant that turns red on the old tests or on the new ones, as designed (16 source mutants and 9 helper mutants);
  - the full suite passes: 273 files, 4028 tests;
  - typecheck passes, and lint still shows 205 warnings, the same as HEAD;
  - the slowest scanner file takes at most 15 % of its timeout under full-suite load.
- **C's rows:** besides the test and mutant checks, C runs three Chromium rows at both viewports: the anonymous `/studio` sign-in guard, a play smoke test, and a real WAV export.
- **Left open, all deferred Lows:**
  - In `ArrangementMixFader`, the `{...props}` spread comes after `type="range"`. That needs an app change, so it can't go in a test-only round.
  - The held-Enter scan is still a text regex.
  - Three small helper refinements from the final review.

**After round 438:** the regression round is due on or after 2026-11-13, then SYS-1, SYS-3, the STORE stages, ARCH-SPLIT (after the frontend-architect checkpoint, which root still has open), REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS and T12-ADVANCED. I added an ARCH-SPLIT rule: each split stage must update the scanners' exact file-path checks in the same change. No new architecture checkpoint was needed this round. The next RETRO is round 450.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
